integrity: The finite sign-pattern step is exhaustive over all thirty-two relative one-angle patterns and is replayed with exact arithmetic in the quadratic field \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt5)\); no numerical approximation is used for the rank obstruction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to real non-tight four-vector equiangular frames spanning three dimensions. It proves that every dual has at least two off-diagonal moduli but does not determine the minimum attainable number beyond that obstruction.
title: No one-angle dual for the non-tight real four-vector equiangular frame
